name: B10-0489/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision authorising the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize DAS1131, pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to allow imports of a genetically modified maize called DAS1131. This maize is engineered to resist certain insects and to tolerate the weedkiller glyphosate. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, especially on long-term effects and on glyphosate's possible link to cancer. It also says Member States never reached a majority for or against, so the Commission should not approve it.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the plan; the maize is not authorised.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, and consumers across the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan.
